option_relations.rationale: Cutaneous metastatic breast carcinoma is a specific type of metastatic breast cancer that affects the skin, which is a subtype of the more general category of cutaneous metastases from breast carcinoma.

Carcinoma erysipeloides is a specific clinical presentation of cutaneous metastatic breast carcinoma, characterized by an erysipeloid appearance, which is a subtype of cutaneous metastases from breast carcinoma.

Telangiectatic metastatic breast carcinoma is a specific histological variant of cutaneous metastatic breast carcinoma, characterized by telangiectasia, which is a subtype of cutaneous metastases from breast carcinoma.
Carcinoma en cuirasse is a sclerodermiform variant of cutaneous metastatic breast carcinoma, which is a subtype of cutaneous metastases from breast carcinoma.
